name: io.github.UModeler/picoberry-mcp
title: PicoBerry
description: Generate game-ready 3D models, images, and animations. Multi-engine, one API.

environmentVariables.name: PICOBERRY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: PicoBerry API key (pb_live_...). Create one at picoberry.ai under Profile > API Keys. Requires a paid plan.

environmentVariables.name: PICOBERRY_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to the PicoBerry production API.
